name: 認定こども園に性暴力防止措置を義務化
summary: 都の条例に、幼保連携型認定こども園で園児への性暴力を防ぐための規定を新たに加えます。設置者は、園児と接する対象の従事者について犯罪事実を確認するなど、性暴力の防止と、被害が起きた場合の園児の保護に必要な措置をとります。令和8年12月25日から施行します。
changes: 園児と接する対象の従事者について、設置者に犯罪事実確認を義務付ける

en.name: Requires certified childcare centers to prevent sexual violence
en.official: Ordinance Partially Amending the Tokyo Metropolitan Government Ordinance on Standards for Class Organization, Staff, Facilities, and Operations of Integrated Certified Centers for Early Childhood Education and Care
en.summary: The Tokyo Metropolitan Government is adding provisions to its ordinance to prevent sexual violence against children at integrated certified centers for early childhood education and care. Operators must take necessary measures to prevent sexual violence and protect children if harm occurs, including checking the criminal records of covered workers who interact with children. The ordinance takes effect on December 25, 2026.
changes: Requires operators to check the criminal records of covered workers who interact with children
Requires operators to take necessary measures to prevent sexual violence and protect children if harm occurs
who: Children at integrated certified centers for early childhood education and care
Operators of integrated certified centers for early childhood education and care
Workers subject to criminal record checks
en.why: The Tokyo Metropolitan Government says this is because laws concerning integrated certified centers for early childhood education and care were amended following the entry into force of related laws.
